item: A language floor that was not read is said, never counted as a floor of zero countries
refs: PR #2241; docket row 279; 0.6 gate rows A and C; R696
key_paths: src/civic/coverage_floor.py; src/law/coverage.py; src/osm/picker.py; src/monitoring/kpi.py; src/api/diagnostics/system.py; src/static/app-map.js; src/static/app-agenda.js; scripts/elections_readback.py; scripts/law_coverage_readback.py; tests/test_language_floor_state_row279.py
summary: configs/language_countries.yml is read once with a state (present, absent, empty, unreadable with the error's class and no path; all rows refused is unreadable) and never raises. When not present, the elections floor, tier report and K13 give None for every floor figure, the law floor and world reports carry the state with the floor's size None, the OSM picker and the Agenda's coverage view say it in one line x12, and the read-back scripts print it. It read 0 floor countries, 0 missing.
